museum_hall_shell.name: Museum Hall Shell (the court, worn)
museum_hall_shell.description: A two-story stone arcade with an iron-and-glass skylight, erected as a purely visual shell around an existing grid map — Cour Marly / Met / Natural History Museum typology as a kit: pier, lintel, cornice, balustrade, glass grid, orange trees, benches. Configurable width/depth/height. The grid below keeps physics and truth; the shell brings the museum light. First worn by Museum_Spine_Court.

museum_uffizi_bay_module.name: Uffizi Bay Module (certified 1 m kit)
museum_uffizi_bay_module.description: An 8 x 8 m repeatable gallery bay assembled from one-metre floor, wall, ceiling and skylight parts. West/east 3 m sockets negotiate endless chaining; the central four-metre wall field remains protected for the featured artifact while props occupy peripheral wall zones.

museum_wall_piece.name: Museum Wall Piece (typed 1-4 m span)
museum_wall_piece.description: A one-metre-grid wall kit family with solid, feature, window, vitrine, service, portal and endcap pieces. Every type spans an exact 1-4 m contract and exposes compatible flat-wall sockets.

museum_wall_run.name: Museum Wall Run (exact-length composer)
museum_wall_run.description: Composes typed museum wall pieces from a compact specification such as service:2|feature:4|solid:2. The resulting run has exact length, gapless internal joints and compatible end sockets.

museum_wall_kit_atlas.name: Museum Wall Kit Atlas (widths + full build)
museum_wall_kit_atlas.description: A physical kitbash sheet that proves every wall family across supported widths and ends with a complete sixteen-metre composed gallery wall.
